mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddd_match_result ( user_number, dog_activity, dog_sociality, dog_independence, dog_barking, dog_grooming, result_created_date ) VALUES ( #{userNumber}, #{dogActivity}, #{dogSociality}, #{dogIndependence}, #{dogBarking}, #{dogGrooming}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.dog_number, a.dog_name, a.dog_breed, a.dog_archive_date, s.shelter_name, ( SELECT ai.archive_img_path FROM ddd_archive_img ai WHERE ai.dog_number = a.dog_number AND ai.archive_img_number = ( SELECT MIN(ai2.archive_img_number) FROM ddd_archive_img ai2 WHERE ai2.dog_number = a.dog_number ) ) AS archive_img_path FROM ddd_archive a LEFT JOIN ddd_user_shelter s ON a.user_number = s.user_number WHERE a.dog_number = #{dogNumber}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ddd_match_result WHERE result_number = ( SELECT result_number FROM ( SELECT result_number FROM ddd_match_result WHERE user_number = #{userNumber} ORDER BY result_created_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) oldest_result )
mapper.select: SELECT result_number, user_number, dog_activity, dog_sociality, dog_independence, dog_barking, dog_grooming, DATE_FORMAT(result_created_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS result_created_date FROM ddd_match_result WHERE user_number = #{userNumber} ORDER BY result_number DESC
SELECT dog_number, dog_activity, dog_sociality, dog_independence, dog_barking, dog_grooming FROM ddd_archive_score
SELECT dog_number FROM ddd_match_result_dog WHERE result_number = #{resultNumber} ORDER BY result_rank ASC

SELECT result_number, user_number, dog_activity, dog_sociality, dog_independence, dog_barking, dog_grooming, DATE_FORMAT(result_created_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS result_created_date FROM ddd_match_result WHERE result_number = #{resultNumber}
